title: Chord poll misses a key whose press and release land in one frame
body: InputNode's held-key set (IsRawKeyHeld) replaced glfwGetKey, which GLFW_STICKY_KEYS latched until the next poll; KeyEdgeTracker samples once per Update, so a press+release inside one frame (a scripted tap, or a very fast real tap) is never seen. Latch 'pressed since last poll' in InputNode and let the tracker consume it. Tier: haiku, one latch + a test.

title: Optional action parameters with declared defaults (single-component typed edits hand-roll keep-current)
body: A typed field sets ONE component, so SetLayerTransform (px..sz) and SetLayerPrimitiveField (x..w) now treat unnamed components as 'keep the current value', hand-coded in each handler, and the triggers need one declaration per component (13 new FlowElementTrigger instances). A declared optional-parameter/keep-current form in the AppFlow schema would remove both the handler code and the per-component trigger fan-out. Owner decision: it is a new declaration form, so not minted here (R688/R757).

title: Host click drains must not dispatch a text control's id as a selector
body: A text control's id is a selector pattern with a value slot ('layer-0-name-{name}'); UISelectionProvider reports a click on it like any element and the editor dispatched it, refusing 'component x is not a number' (found live on Dozen). EditorApplication now skips ids with a slot (HasValueSlot) but every host that drains clicks must remember to. Move the skip into the drain seam (UISelectionProviderNode::DrainClickedElementId or UIRenderNode) so it is one rule.

title: Resync after a commit dirties every bound variable
body: UIRenderNode::DirtyAllViewVariables re-evaluates the whole data model after any commit so a refused text value snaps back; correct but coarse (one full re-evaluation per commit, not per frame). A per-control resync (re-apply only the committed element's data-attr-value) would be precise; measure before changing (not measured here).

title: Editor hidden-window Dozen runs log non-acquired-swapchain-image validation errors
body: Observed in every sn-rmlinput1 witness run (editor.log, VK_LAYER validation, UNASSIGNED-non-acquired-swapchain-image-used on vkQueueSubmit2KHR layout transition of a presentable image); present on the base path, unrelated to input. Pre-existing; needs a measurement lane.
